claims: Generation Z refers to individuals born between 1997 and 2012.
Generation Z is often called Zoomers.
As of 2026, Generation Z ranges from teens to roughly 29 years old.
BambooHR states that the Gen Z age range covers anyone born between 1997 and 2012.
BambooHR states that Generation Z makes up 20% of the US population as of 2023.
Wikipedia states that Generation Z is often shortened to Gen Z.
Wikipedia states that Generation Z is informally known as Zoomers.
Wikipedia states that Generation Z is the demographic cohort succeeding Millennials.
Gen Z's birth years are generally accepted to be between 1996 and 2012.
GWI states that Generation Z is the generation after millennials.
GWI states that Generation Z is the generation before Gen Alpha.
